photos.title: Conway city hall 0782
photos.what: Conway City Hall from the corner of Main Street and Third Avenue: a two-story brick building with a white portico of four columns over arched openings, stairs up both sides, a white clock tower in wooden scaffolding beside it, a U.S. flag, palmettos, Spanish moss in an oak at the left, a street sign reading Third, and a red car parked on the right.
photos.caption: Conway City Hall on Main Street, once the county courthouse.
photos.alt: Conway City Hall, a brick building with a white portico of four columns and stairs up both sides, beside a white clock tower and palmetto trees

place.sublocation: City Hall, Main Street at Third Avenue

photos.author: Pollinator at en.wikipedia
photos.credit: Photo: Pollinator at en.wikipedia, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
photos.provenance: Own work of the author, transferred from en.wikipedia (Commons Credit field: Own work; Transferred from en.wikipedia; original upload 2006-11-23). Downloaded as the Commons 1920 px thumbnail on 2026-11-02 (the original 2100x1400 was rate-limited).
photos.license_note: Commons extmetadata 2026-11-02: LicenseShortName CC BY-SA 3.0, AttributionRequired true. Our resized copy is shared under the same licence.
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (1920 px) by the writer of /submarkets/conway/ on 2026-11-02. It shows the building the NRHP nomination (ledger row 29) names as the old courthouse that now serves as City Hall: the white portico and brick body, with a sign by the steps reading City Hall and the Third street sign. No person; the plate of the red car is not readable at page size; the shop sign at the right edge is cut off.
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty resized the photo and cut 1x1, 4x3 and 16x9 crops
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of the 1920x1280 thumbnail by tools/photos.js crops; each shows the portico and the clock tower.

photos.caption: Kimbel Library at Coastal Carolina University, under a live oak.
photos.alt: A red brick library building with white doors behind a wide live oak with long low limbs, and two palmettos, at Coastal Carolina University in Conway

photos.alt: A wooden boardwalk with a black railing, shaded by trees, beside old wooden buildings in Conway
photos.author: Pubdog
photos.credit: Photo: Pubdog, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.caption: The boardwalk along the Waccamaw River, at the edge of downtown Conway.
photos.subject_check: Reused on /submarkets/conway/ (looked at full size, 1200 px, 2026-11-02): a wooden boardwalk with a black rail under sycamores beside old wooden riverfront buildings, the US 501 bridge in the distance. photos.title: Hurricane Florence - South Carolina National Guard Responds (44200296354)
photos.what: A street of single-story houses with floodwater across the road and the yards, a basketball hoop and road signs standing in the water, trees and a power pole reflected in the water, under a gray sky.
photos.caption: Floodwater on a street of houses in the Conway area after Florence.
photos.alt: Floodwater covering a residential street and the yards of single-story houses, with road signs standing in the water, in the Conway area after Hurricane Florence

place.sublocation: Conway area, South Carolina (the source does not name the street)
